description: This Swift source file defines structures and functions for managing device authentication tokens, including loading, storing, and clearing tokens, with persistent storage to a JSON file. It provides a static API for device token management.

classes.name: DeviceAuthEntry
classes.description: A Codable and Sendable struct representing an authentication token, its role, scopes, and last update timestamp.

methods.name: loadToken
methods.description: Loads a device authentication token for a given device ID and role from persistent storage.

methods.name: storeToken
methods.description: Stores or updates a device authentication token with role, token string, and optional scopes.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes a token associated with a device ID and role from persistent storage.

methods.name: normalizeRole
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines from a role string.

methods.name: normalizeScopes
methods.description: Trims whitespace from scopes, filters out empty strings, and sorts them uniquely.

methods.name: fileURL
methods.description: Constructs the URL to the JSON storage file.

methods.name: readStore
methods.description: Reads the token store from the JSON file, decoding it into a DeviceAuthStoreFile object.

methods.name: writeStore
methods.description: Encodes and writes the token store to the JSON file, setting permissions to 600.
